FORMAL BLOCK — provider-parser successor c7a9ba6ee80b566b3f0f658dced5903ab78ade6c, candidate cand-0NM8VRWP6D52NNS9S2AJGC1KQ7.

The new branch matrix and input/call-bound witnesses close the three previously demonstrated forged tuples. One fail-closed/cache-key closure defect remains at result.scala:741-762: ParserAttempt.failed(input, failure, malformedReceipt, Some(key)) rejects through from, then contractViolation drops expectedCacheKey, omits CacheMiss(key), and directly constructs new ParserAttempt. The emitted fallback is therefore not reconstructable through the public checked door under the same cache context.

Independent exact-archive mutation at c7a9ba6:
- added a package test calling failed with an impossible callless MalformedEnvelope receipt and Some(ParserCacheKey.of(...));
- asserted ParserAttempt.from(input, emitted.result, emitted.receipt, Some(key)).isRight;
- providerParser/testOnly compiled and failed exactly that assertion (1 failed, 0 errors).

This is reachable as a fail-closed postcondition in every cache call site that passes Some(key), even if current normal receipts happen to classify. Required repair: thread the expected key into the canonical contract-violation fallback, emit the corresponding legal cache decision/context, and construct or re-enter it through the checked door. Add the Some(key) regression alongside the existing no-key internal-failure test.
